thread:
sasha: Heads up — canary promotion paused. CI failing on e2e-db-seed in two different jobs, 50% flake rate :grimacing:
cheng: which job ids? can you paste the failing trace?
sasha: job 7891 and 7892. gist of failure:
```
AssertionError: user 'test_seed_42' not found in DB after seed
  File "tests/e2e/test_signup.py", line 34, in test_seeded_user
    assert db.get_user('test_seed_42')
```
maria: that's the flaky DB seeding we saw last month. usually a race with migrations and the seed container starting late.
oliver: deploy-bot reported a partial rollout at 10% before the will-canary step. we should abort promotion until we repro consistently.
deploy-bot: canary promotion halted by human: @sasha — automatic rollback disabled. See /deploy/1234 for details.
sasha: thinking: pin the canary to commit sha: ab12c3f, roll back the 10% hosts to previous image, and open a hotfix branch to reproduce locally. anyone opposed?
cheng: +1. also recommend we add a small pre-deploy wait for DB readiness in the canary job (30s) while we investigate.
maria: can we run the e2e job with DB logs enabled (verbose seed output)? i want timestamps for seed start/finished.
qa-bot: quick check: recent infra change merged yesterday touched the migration order. PR 5123. Could be related.
oliver: ok i'm initiating rollback and pin now. rolling back canary hosts -> image tag redwood/service@ab12c3f
sasha: TY. I'll open the hotfix branch and run the seed locally against a fresh DB. if reproduction is >80% we cut a patch. otherwise we add the wait + tracing and reschedule promotion to the next change window (tomorrow 02:00 UTC).
cheng: also adding a note in the release notes draft: "Canary hold due to intermittent DB seed failure; rollback applied; root-cause investigation ongoing."
maria: if rollback completes, can someone re-run the full pipeline on a staging cluster with PR 5123 reverted? that will help isolate.
oliver: rollback finished on 10 hosts. deploy-bot: rollback completed for /deploy/1234 at 2024-11-09T16:12:30Z :white_check_mark:
sasha: thanks. leaving thread open for postmortem anchor. I'll add links to logs and the repro steps once I have them. :memo:
